name: Silverwing Outpost
summary: Silverwing Outpost guards the eastern bank of the Falfarren River in south-central Ashenvale. Duriel Moonfire commands the garrison, the Alliance's easternmost hold against the Horde in the contested woodland.

sections.title: East of the Falfarren
sections.body: Silverwing Outpost lies southwest of Splintertree Post and just north of the Barrens border. Its place on the eastern bank of the Falfarren River puts it in territory the Horde contests and patrols. From here, the garrison shields night elf holdings deeper in the forest. Duriel Moonfire and her Silverwing Sentinels face constant attacks from nearby orcs seeking to drive night elf forces from the area.

sections.title: The Constant Front
sections.body: Fierce skirmishes rage around Silverwing Outpost. Orcish war parties from Splintertree Post, including raiders led by Torek, ambush the garrison at its walls. The Horde seeks to neutralize the outpost, secure the road, and expand its resource operations without Sentinel counterattacks.

faq.answer: Silverwing Outpost stands in south-central Ashenvale, southwest of Splintertree Post, north of the Barrens border, and east of the Falfarren River.
Duriel Moonfire commands Silverwing Outpost and leads the Silverwing Sentinels defending the forest's eastern reaches.

faq.q: Why does the Horde target this outpost so aggressively?
faq.answer: Silverwing Outpost stands east of the Falfarren River near Splintertree Post. The Silverwing Sentinels there can cut off Horde supply lines and threaten orcish operations in Ashenvale.
The Silverwing Sentinels are night elf warriors and huntresses who protect Ashenvale from incursions, especially Horde lumber camps and war parties.

angles.text: Silverwing Outpost is your forward stronghold east of the river, checking orc expansion from Splintertree Post.
For the Horde, Silverwing Outpost obstructs movements and supply lines through southern Ashenvale from Splintertree Post.
